items.title: Bring AWS Security Hub CSPM findings into your Amazon CloudWatch on-call workflow
items.summary: At 2:47 AM, an on-call engineer gets paged: CPU on a production Amazon EC2 instance has been above 95% for five minutes. They open Amazon CloudWatch and run the usual triage, checking recent deployments, traffic spikes, memory, and disk I/O. Nothing lines up. They scale the instance; utilization climbs back within minutes. Thirty-two minutes later, […]
